'''Blue Squadron''', also known as '''Blue Flight''', '''Blue Group''', or '''Blue Wing''', was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] active in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] flew [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wings]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] among other [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] used in the Rebel fleet.

==History==
===Aboard ''Independence''===
When stationed aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], Blue Squadron personnel such as senior [[Flight leader/Legends|flight leader]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ernek Marskan]] flew [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]], and [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|A-wing starfighters]]. While carrying the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]], [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] flew a Blue Squadron X-wing that was [[Rescue of Biggs Darklighter|rescued]] from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack near the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]]. The squadron later transferred to [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]] just prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="XWTOSG" />

===''Tantive IV''===
A group of fighters named Blue Squadron served as scouts for [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], arriving over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] ahead of the Princess' [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]]. Surprised by the absence of [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] activity reported in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|system]], "[[Blue Leader/Legends|Blue Leader]]" nevertheless cleared the ''Tantive'' for approach, unwittingly springing an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|trap]] set by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="EaW" />

===Battle of Yavin===
Blue Squadron served at the Rebel base on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and participated in the Battle of Yavin under the command of Blue Leader Captain [[Merrick Simms]].<ref name="RA" /> The squadron was made up of six pilots, all flying X-wings.<ref name="FF1">{{FactFile2013|1|YAV 1-4|The Battle of Yavin}}</ref> It was essential in clearing the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star's]] surface of turrets, and neutralized a larger [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] emplacement.<ref name="RA" /> Their main goal was to join [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] in an attack run on the station's superlaser in the hope of distracting the Empire from the exhaust port attack.<ref name="TEGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*Blue Leader - Captain Merrick Simms<ref name="RA" />
*[[Blue Two/Legends|Blue Two]] - [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ru Murleen]]<ref name="RA" />
*[[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]] - "[[Rookie One]]"<ref name="RA" />
*[[Blue Four/Legends|Blue Four]] - [[Thurlow Harris]]<ref name="RA" />

===Rescue of Domina Tagge===
During the [[Yavin blockade]], a Blue Flight led by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was involved in the [[rescue of Domina Tagge]]. Tagge, along with other representatives of the [[Order of the Sacred Circle]], were under attack by four Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. During the engagement, three TIE fighters were destroyed, while the fourth retreated back to its [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], which fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].<ref name="MC35" />
*Blue Leader - Luke Skywalker

===Attack on Arda II===
{{Quote|Can the chatter! Blue Five&hellip; Break left!|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="ALAWL">"[[As Long As We Live...]]"</ref>}}
Six X-wings of Skywalker's Blue Flight<ref name="TCDV">{{SWArchive|url=episode-v/bts/article/f20070124/index.html|text=Time Capsule: Darth Vader 1980}}</ref> traveled with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia Organa to the neutral world of [[Arda II]] to investigate the presence of [[T-6 diodem]] targeting equipment in the weapons systems of Imperial TIE fighters. When Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Mag Doum]] alerted Darth Vader to the Rebels' presence, [[Zon Zorad]], a regretful accomplice of Doum's, flew with Blue Flight in injured pilot [[Cova]]'s X-wing as the flight attempted to repulse Vader's forces' [[attack on Arda II|attack]] on Arda II. Zorad was shot down by a TIE fighter, perishing alongside his [[Kiros Zorad|father]] and Mag Doum in a collision with Vader's Star Destroyer, damaging the Imperial ship and forcing the attackers to retreat.<ref name="ALAWL" />

===Endor===
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of Blue Squadron's [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighters]] and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] was ordered to destroy a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bomber]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. However, when it appeared that the Imperial bombers were reinforced by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], [[Havoc Squadron]] was dispatched to support Blue Squadron.<ref name="SWG:ABSidaTBw" />

===Battle of Hoth===
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], members from the Rebellion's Blue and Green Squadrons and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]] were cobbled together and pressed into service as a unified "Rogue Squadron," doubling up as pilots and [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] aboard the Rebels' [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]].<ref name="TEGW" /> The remaining Blues and Greens either piloted evacuating transports or their fighter escorts.<ref name="Insider146">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref>

*Blue Three - [[Will Scotian/Legends|Will Scotian]]<ref name="Insider146" />
*Blue Four - [[Gemmer Sojan/Legends|Gemmer Sojan]]<ref name="Insider146" />
*[[Blue Eight/Legends|Blue Eight]] - [[Beryann Raleg]]<ref name="Insider146" />
*[[Blue Twelve/Legends|Blue Twelve]] - [[Kulbart Zamoon]]<ref name="Insider146" />

===Raid on Golrath Station===
Blue Squadron was joined by [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] for an [[Raid on Golrath Station|expedition]] to an [[Golrath Station|abandoned Rebel base]] on [[Golrath/Legends|Golrath]] to destroy records of their activities contained within the rock of the base's walls. The two squadrons of X-wing and Y-wing starfighters conducted a diversionary raid against the occupying Imperial forces, while Princess Leia Organa attempted to infiltrate the station and sabotage the reactor.<ref name="SW65" />

===Ral's Run===
Blue Squadron raided [[Ral's Run]]. On one sortie, they were [[Ambush on Ral's Run|ambushed]] by the ''[[Imperial Protector]]'', but the Squadron destroyed the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|escort carrier]], with [[Dex (Blue Squadron)|Dex]] claiming credit.<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>

===First Battle of Bothawui===
{{Main|Blue Squadron (Bothan)}}

Following the Battle of Hoth, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] formed an unofficial Blue Squadron of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Y-wing pilots for a [[Raid on the Suprosa|raid on the ''Suprosa'']]. Many Bothans died on that mission.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

===Aboard ''Defiance''===
Another Blue Squadron was assigned to the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']] during the build up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. At least one pilot, [[Blue Eight (Defiance)|Blue Eight]], was killed in action at the time.<ref name="XWA" />
*Blue Leader - [[Olin Garn]]<ref name="XWAOSG" />
*Blue Two - [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]]<ref name="XWA" />
*Blue Eight - Unknown pilot

===Battle of Endor===
[[File:Blue_Leader_BotF.png|thumb|right|250px|Merrick Simms flying as Blue Leader at the Battle of Endor]]
Blue Squadron, otherwise identified as Blue Group<ref name="Return of the Jedi (novel)">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'': ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> or Blue Wing,<ref name="AGSWU" /> flew heavily armed [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighters]] and [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptors]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="CSWEBS" /> The squadron's B-wings were maintained by Verpine mechanics, and were equipped with armor-piercing missiles.<ref name="CCGBSBW">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Blue Squadron B-wing}}</ref> While the identifier Blue Wing was used to refer to the [[Fighter wing/Legends|battle wing]] itself as a whole, it was also used as a [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] by Blue Leader Captain Merrick Simms'<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Blue Wing|second-in-command]].<ref name="CSWEBW">{{CSWECite|I|81|Blue Wing}}</ref>

One of the Alliance's main attack elements in the battle,<ref name="AGSWU" /> Blue Squadron's B-wings were given orders to attack Imperial command ships, with [[Blue Five/Legends|Blue Five]] [[Ten Numb/Legends|Ten Numb]] leading an attack on the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Deadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']],<ref name="CCGTN">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Ten Numb}}</ref><ref name="CCGBS5">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Blue Squadron 5}}</ref> and Blue Leader participating in an attack run on the Empire's damaged [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|main communications ship]].<ref name="Return of the Jedi (novel)" />

*Blue Leader - Captain Merrick Simms<ref name="SWE" />
*Blue Wing - Unknown pilot
*Blue Five - Ten Numb<ref name="CCGTN" />
*[[Blue Seven/Legends|Blue Seven]] - [[Palso Thern/Legends|Palso Thern]]<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (2 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tvcexbattleoverendor2.asp}}</ref>
*[[Blue Nine/Legends|Blue Nine]] - [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]]<ref name="LEGOSDCC">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fbtb.net/lego-star-wars/2014/07/24/sdcc-the-lego-star-wars-minifigure-gallery|text=SDCC - The LEGO Star Wars Minifigure Gallery at FBTB.net|archivedate=20200929031301}}</ref>

Captain Simms perished in the wake of the exploding Imperial communications ship, thrown by the shock wave against a smaller Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]], which was itself destroyed. Later in the battle, "Blue Wing" led [[Blue Squad]], an A-wing squadron within the Blue Wing attack element,<ref name="AGSWU" /> in joining [[Gold Leader/Legends|Gold Leader]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] attack on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]], before breaking off to draw a group of pursuing [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]] away from Calrissian and [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] Commander [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] as they entered the Death Star's superstructure.<ref name="Return of the Jedi (novel)" />

Although the Alliance succeeded in destroying the second Death Star, the Battle of Endor inflicted the loss of their commanding officer on Blue Squadron.<ref name="Return of the Jedi (novel)" /> One week after the battle, Ten Numb had taken over as Blue Leader and flew a B-wing refitted to fight forest fires raging across the forest moon.<ref name="XWRL1" /> He was recruited by [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] Luke Skywalker for a ground mission on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], but was [[Raid at Coronet|captured by Imperial forces]] and [[Mission to Tralus|killed shortly thereafter]] on [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]].<ref name="XWRL3">[[X-Wing: Rogue Leader 3|''X-Wing: Rogue Leader'' 3]]</ref>

===New Republic Service===
{{Main|Blue Squadron (New Republic)}}

After the reformation of the Rebel Alliance into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], a Blue Squadron was protecting the Alliance [[flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[New Hope]]''. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], along with the makeshift "[[Medpac Squadron]]", they followed the ''Millennium Falcon'' in the [[battle in the Milagro system]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

A Blue Squadron of A-wing interceptors was assigned to the [[Folor Base|New Republic base]] on [[Folor]] to support [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="XWWS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BlueSquadronDS-RA.jpg|thumb|250px|The version of Blue Squadron appearing in ''Star Wars: Rebel Assault'']]
During the making of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the X-wing squadron that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was assigned to was given the designation "Blue Squadron." When it was realized that the blue markings on Blue Squadron's starfighters would be replaced by background footage during shots that incorporated a blue-screen, Blue Squadron was renamed "[[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]" and the name of the Y-wing squadron that originally bore that name was changed to "[[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]."<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> This change was not reflected in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization of ''A New Hope'']], which used the original designations for the squadron.<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref>

The information concerning the Battle of Yavin and the names of the pilots is derived from the S-canonical game ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' and is given with caution. The squadron seen defending ''Tantive IV'' in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' may also be non-canonical.<ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1062#16021160|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2006-12-07|time=6:15 PM|quote=Rookiee One's tench run in non-continuity. There was less attention to staying within continuity for some of the older games.}}</ref><ref>{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1860#17269953|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2008-05-28|time=1:52 PM|quote=Does this include Star Wars: Episode I: Racer/Battlefront I: Story is S, but locations, characters, and technology are C. And by extension, Battlefront II Story is C.}}</ref>
